findings.description: Critical: `_load_secrets_openbao()` catches a missing or non-dict KV-v2 secret document (`data = response.get("data", {}).get("data", {})`) by logging a warning and returning `{}` instead of raising an error. This violates CFG-27 ("THEN internal loading SHALL raise the corresponding missing-credential, authentication, or timeout error without starting with partial secrets") and CFG-22 ("a failed internal read SHALL not silently fall back to file secrets"). If the secret document is empty or malformed, the coordinator proceeds without internal secrets rather than failing loud on startup.
findings.resolution: Raise `RuntimeError("OpenBao internal secret document is missing or malformed")` when `data` is not an instance of `dict`, preventing the coordinator from starting with missing secrets.

findings.description: Optional: When the 120-second snapshot grace window expires (`time.monotonic() - state.installed_at > GRACE_SECONDS`), `readiness()` and `lookup()` deny authentication and report degraded readiness, but fail to emit the `openbao.identity.snapshot_expired` audit event defined in `contracts/openbao-event.schema.json`. Without emitting this lifecycle transition event with action expire, audit sinks have no event indicating when the last-known-good snapshot expired.
findings.resolution: Track snapshot expiration state (serialized via lock or atomic guard) and emit `openbao.identity.snapshot_expired` with action="expire" and error_code="TOKEN_EXPIRED" once the grace window is exceeded.

findings.description: none: `build_identity_snapshot()` reads all keyed agents from `load_agents_config()` using the dedicated identity-reader service principal (`service/identity-reader`), rejects empty, missing, or duplicate keys with `SECRET_MALFORMED`, and constructs an immutable candidate map wrapped in `MappingProxyType`. The active snapshot is replaced in a single atomic assignment, ensuring requests never observe partially loaded identities.
findings.resolution: No action needed; complies with D2, D4, and AI-03, AI-04, COORD-02.

findings.description: none: In configured Bao mode, `_principal_for_api_key()` exclusively queries the installed snapshot, ignoring `COORDINATION_API_KEYS` and static JSON identity overrides for authentication. Cutover preflight strictly checks configured static keys against candidate OpenBao agent identities on initial load and reports unbound keys as blockers (`COORDINATION_API_KEYS[N]`) without disclosing secret values.
findings.resolution: No action needed; complies with D4, COORD-09, and AI-05.

findings.description: none: `GET /ready` evaluates database and identity health independently using monotonic clock measurements. During the 120s grace period following a failed reload, `GET /ready` returns HTTP 200 with status: degraded and identity: degraded while maintaining key routability. It correctly yields HTTP 503 upon initial hydration failure or grace expiry, and returns identity: disabled (HTTP 200) when Bao is disabled, strictly conforming to contracts/openapi/v1.yaml.
findings.resolution: No action needed; complies with D4, COORD-03, COORD-04, COORD-06, COORD-08, COORD-10.

findings.description: none: Structured identity events adhere to contracts/openbao-event.schema.json with sanitized fields (principal_id, resource: identity_snapshot, snapshot_age_seconds, and typed error_code). Error handling in config.py and profile_loader.py strips backend exception messages and suppresses chained tracebacks (from None), preventing token or credential leakage.

findings.resolution: No action needed; complies with D4, COORD-07, and CFG-20.

findings.description: none: OpenBaoConfig renames authentication inputs to BAO_INTERNAL_ROLE_ID and BAO_INTERNAL_SECRET_ID, preventing legacy BAO_ROLE_ID/BAO_SECRET_ID from authenticating internal secret loading. The identity reader uses PrincipalOpenBaoConfig with a distinct service principal (service-identity-reader), ensuring clear separation between internal profile loading and agent identity resolution.
findings.resolution: No action needed; complies with D5, CFG-19, CFG-21, CFG-22, and CFG-26.
